units.source_text: 原来是开馆前的时候，外国兵就来参观了。

en.t: It turned out that before the temple had even opened, foreign soldiers had already come to visit.

units.source_text: 老导游用手势比划着让他们稍候，便来招唤"通晓英语"的我。

en.t: The old guide gestured for them to wait a moment, then came to summon me, the one who was supposed to know English.

units.source_text: 说来也奇怪，我的英语居然比鹤川说得流畅，而且说起英语来，我也不结巴了。

en.t: Strange as it may sound, my English was actually more fluent than Tsurukawa's, and when I spoke English, I did not stutter either.
